title: JSON Schema Validation
description: Validates JSON files against official JSON schemas located at public/schemas. Reports schema validation errors and warns when files are not at a current format version. Topic IDs 100+ are computed as JsonSchemaErrorBase (100) + ProjectItemType. Topic IDs 1100+ are computed as NotCurrentFormatVersionBase (1100) + ProjectItemType.

1.title: JSON Parse Error
1.description: The file could not be parsed as valid JSON. Check for syntax errors like missing commas, brackets, or quotes.
